name: Aqua Dome
kurzbeschreibung: AQUA DOME in Längenfeld impresses as an architectural flagship thermal resort with three floating bowl basins and panoramic views of the Ötztal Alps.
beschreibung:
Overview

The AQUA DOME – Tirol Therme Längenfeld is one of the most spectacular thermal bath and wellness resorts in the entire Alps. Embedded in the wide valley basin of Längenfeld in the Ötztal at 1,173 meters above sea level, the resort blends futuristic architecture with the natural power of alpine thermal water. More than 50,000 m² of total resort area and around 2,200 m² of water surface offer wellness seekers and families a first-class thermal spa experience against the majestic backdrop of the glaciated Ötztal three-thousanders.

Architecture & Thermal Water

The distinctive landmark of AQUA DOME, which opened in 2004, are the three floating bowl basins in the outdoor area, hovering on gigantic pillars above the ground like futuristic flying saucers. Each bowl offers a unique sensory experience: a whirlpool bowl with massage jets, a sulfur bowl fed by pure thermal water, and a brine bowl with fine sea salt, underwater music, and ambient lighting effects. The heart of the indoor complex is the huge, light-flooded Thermendom Ursprung with two large indoor pools kept at pleasant temperatures of 34 °C and 36 °C. The therapeutic thermal water bubbles up from a depth of 1,865 meters; approximately three to four liters per second of sulfur water containing fluoride and sodium chloride feed the pools. The resort is complemented by the expansive sauna world Gletscherglühen (including a loft sauna, earth sauna, and hay barn), the exclusive VIP zone SPA 3000 for hotel and day spa guests, and the separate family water world Alpen Arche Noah with tube water slides and children's pools.

Visit & Getting There

The thermal spa is open 365 days a year: daily from 09:00 to 23:00 (pools close at 22:30), with popular moonlight bathing every Friday until midnight. Admission prices (as of 2025/2026): regular adult day ticket approx. €59.00 (available from approx. €47.20 via the daily online early bird booking system); flexible 3-hour tickets from approx. €28.00 to €38.00; sauna surcharge approx. €20.00. Children (3–14 years) enjoy reduced rates, toddlers under 3 enter free. By car: via the Inntalautobahn A12, exit Ötztal, then follow the B186 (Ötztalstraße) approx. 22 km into the valley directly to Längenfeld (free underground and outdoor parking available). By public transport: take ÖBB trains to Ötztal-Bahnhof station, then board VVT bus line 4194 (Ötztaler Linienbus) running every half hour directly to the Längenfeld Therme stop (travel time approx. 35 minutes).

Tips

The entire thermal resort is designed to be barrier-free and fully wheelchair accessible: threshold-free entrances, elevators to all levels, and a dedicated pool lift ensure comfortable water access for visitors with reduced mobility. We strongly recommend booking your admission tickets online in advance to avoid waiting at the ticket desk and to benefit from up to 20% early-bird discounts.
